about.text: A semi-hard oval stretched-curd cheese from the Ariano Irpino area of Avellino. The curd is dipped in boiling water and hand-shaped into ovals of 10 to 11 kg, then brined and aged for several months; a cold-smoked straw variant also exists.

sources.text: The process, ageing, area and PAT status, from this article.
